branch_activations.activation: Yielding to the parents' specified demand is directly blocked, so pressure does not decide the addressee's action.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The refusal is a practical limit on compliance.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch concerns this demand, not every kind of obedience.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek, iki tarafın yakın ve süreğen biçimde birlikte bulunması ya da birinin ötekine eşlik etmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: Ṣāhibhumā carries sustained company and close accompaniment.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The same dual parents are named in the prior refused obedience command.
branch_activations.activation: Company is commanded after compliance is refused, allowing the relationship to continue in a different mode.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Closeness remains possible without surrendering judgment to the demand.
branch_activations.boundary: The relation is companionship; no claim of unrestricted agreement follows.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: iyi sayılan ve benimsenen davranış veya iyilik
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir davranış insanın iç dünyasınca benimsenir ve düşünce ya da bağlayıcı ölçüler bakımından iyi sayılır.
branch_activations.carrier: Maʿrūfan carries a recognized and normatively approved good.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding companionship command supplies the relation whose manner it qualifies.
branch_activations.activation: The recognized-good standard gives continued company an affirmative ethical quality after refusal.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The reader sees a positive measure for maintaining the bond rather than mere tolerance.
branch_activations.boundary: The ayah does not enumerate every act that fulfills this standard.

findings.title: A knowledge threshold and a return-marked route
findings.claim: The unsupported association is closed off, while the path is identified by following one whose orientation is return to God.
findings.mechanism: The negated knowledge predicate meets the path noun, following imperative, and returner criterion; knowledge as a guiding mark and repeated return make the alternative route criterion-based rather than inherited from parental pressure.
findings.reader_payoff: Refusal is paired with a positive wayfinding criterion: a path can be followed because its direction is legible in the returner's conduct.
findings.containment: The ayah supplies a path and a returner criterion, not an explicit investigation procedure; no step-by-step tracing is claimed.

epistemic.reason: The focus words and registered branches support the bounded route relation, while the HFT's extra stepwise-tracing role lacks a distinct search sequence and is excluded.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: özneyi yalın, yüklemi belirtme durumunda tutan geçmiş biçimli olumsuzluk eylemi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir durum ya da niteliğin özne için geçerli olmadığını bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: Laysa denies that a state or quality applies to the proposed object.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The association target and the knowledge term specify what is negated.
branch_activations.activation: The absence of knowledge closes the demanded claim before the ayah introduces another direction.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The demand is treated as an unmarked claim that cannot govern the addressee.
branch_activations.boundary: This is the local copular negation, not a universal grammatical use of laysa.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ayırt edici ve yol gösterici işaret
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi ve kumaşın kenar deseni yön bulduran veya tanıtan somut gerçekleşmelerdir.
branch_activations.carrier: ʿIlm can carry the image of a distinguishing mark that guides or identifies.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The following path and returner criterion supply a separate wayfinding context.
branch_activations.activation: The absent warrant is set beside a route whose direction is identified by a person's return to God.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Knowledge is newly legible as the mark that would orient a claim, while the returner's conduct marks the alternative.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not make every use of knowledge a literal sign or every path a physical road.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yol ve bir amaca ulaştıran yol
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsanların üzerinde yürüyüp ilerlediği uzanmış yol veya yolları belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: Sabil carries an extended road or route that can be traversed.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Ittabiʿ commands following it, and man anaba ilayya identifies its criterion.
branch_activations.activation: The route noun meets a command to follow and a person defined by returning, making guidance a traversable direction.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The alternative to obedience is an active route with a stated orientation.
branch_activations.boundary: The ayah does not supply a detailed map or claim that the route is a literal road.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yere, kişiye ya da yöne bir kez değil, alışkanlıkla ve tekrar tekrar dönme veya gitme.
branch_activations.carrier: Anāba can carry a repeated return or renewed orientation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later marjiʿukum and the destination ilayya repeat return as the ayah's closing movement.
branch_activations.activation: A voluntary returner is placed beside the eventual return of all addressees, making return a durable orientation rather than one declaration.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The followable model is recognized by a repeated God-directed pattern.
branch_activations.boundary: No exact count or biography of the returner's changes is supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi yanlışından döner ve Tanrı'ya yönelir.
branch_activations.carrier: Anāba in this branch carries turning from wrong and turning toward God.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The earlier pressured association and its refusal provide the local contrast.
branch_activations.activation: The returner's direction meets the refused association, so following the returner is a turn away from the proposed partnership and toward God.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The path's criterion includes moral reorientation, not merely movement toward a destination.
branch_activations.boundary: The verse does not say that every person being followed previously committed this act.

findings.title: Chosen return inside a shared final accountability
findings.claim: A person's deliberate return to God is nested within the final return of all addressees, after which their deeds are disclosed.
findings.mechanism: The carrier anāba meets the later marjiʿukum; the return noun then meets divine informing and the action clause, turning a guide's chosen orientation into a universal accountability horizon.
findings.reader_payoff: The path instruction is followed by a larger frame: the exemplar's return is chosen, while the addressees' final return and report include everyone.
findings.containment: The focus supports final return and disclosure of deeds but gives no detailed resurrection scene, timing, or report beyond the actions named.

epistemic.reason: The local return/report sequence is supported by trusted word evidence; the HFT source is legacy_unbound, and its news-branch trace is retained only as attributed because the branch registry identity conflicts.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey alıştığı yere birden çok kez geri döner.
branch_activations.carrier: Anāba carries repeated return or renewed orientation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Marjiʿukum and the repeated destination ilayya name a later return.
branch_activations.activation: The voluntary returner's pattern meets the unavoidable return of all addressees.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Chosen reorientation and final return become two different scales of the same direction.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not identify how many times the person returned.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Özne, başladığı yere ya da daha önce bulunduğu duruma geri döner.
branch_activations.carrier: Marjiʿukum carries a return to an earlier place or state.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Anāba gives a voluntary return before the later divine informing.
branch_activations.activation: The return noun gathers the earlier voluntary direction into a shared final destination that leads to disclosure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The guide's chosen return is set beside a final return belonging to the plural addressees.
branch_activations.boundary: The word does not specify the physical route or exact timing.

branch_activations.carrier: Unabbiʾukum is the divine informing verb at the exact focus occurrence.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The return noun and the deeds named in the final clause supply the attributed report context.
branch_activations.activation: The HFT role connects the informing to consequential news after return; the surface root at word 26 is n-b-ʾ, but root_001464 is labeled n-w-b elsewhere in the packet, so no independent gloss or facet is imported.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final return is followed by an informing about performed deeds.
branch_activations.boundary: This is an attributed HFT role only; the branch identity conflict blocks a dictionary gloss and no report detail beyond the deeds is claimed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: Kuntum carries being or occurrence as a temporal frame.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The following imperfect deed verb and informing clause supply the action being reported.
branch_activations.activation: The being-frame lets the report gather conduct extending through time rather than one isolated instant.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Accountability concerns lived action with temporal depth.
branch_activations.boundary: No frequency or duration is specified.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem anlamı çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: Taʿmalūn carries intentional work or performed action.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Kuntum frames the verb over time, and mā gathers it as the report's content.
branch_activations.activation: The action term supplies the concrete material of disclosure rather than mere affiliation or claim.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The ending lands on what people did.
branch_activations.boundary: The verse does not classify each deed here.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ölümden sonra dönüş ve yeniden diriliş
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsanın son varışının Tanrı'nın huzuru olması nihai dönüş olarak kavranır.
branch_activations.carrier: Marjiʿukum can carry the ultimate arrival of people before God.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The following divine report of deeds supplies an accountability trigger.
branch_activations.activation: The return destination meets the report of conduct, making the return eschatological in scope rather than an ordinary change of place.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The reader can hear the closing return as final accountability before God.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the final arrival/accountability facet is retained; no detailed resurrection scene or timing is asserted.

findings.title: Worldly companionship is real and bounded
findings.claim: The commanded companionship is active and good within this near-world life, while the later return places that bond within a wider final horizon.
findings.mechanism: Ṣāhibhumā maʿrūfan carries care, al-dunyā supplies the near/first-life domain, and marjiʿukum ilayya supplies the independent return; their contact makes parental nearness real but not ultimate.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees continued family care and final accountability coexist without treating either as a substitute for the other.
findings.containment: This does not say care ends at death or that parents have no rights; it retains the ayah's worldly scope and shared return while excluding the incompatible human-partnership branch.

epistemic.reason: Exact focus words support the bounded near-world relation; HFT is legacy_unbound, and its shared-ownership branch is excluded because that branch's own boundary rules out religious association.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kimsenin kendisine eşlik eden bir gözetim ve destek yoluyla korunması çekirdeği oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: Ṣāhibhumā carries accompanied protection and support.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Maʿrūfan qualifies the companionship, while the pressure clause makes the relationship one under strain.
branch_activations.activation: Good conduct toward the pressured parents gives continued company a supportive quality rather than bare tolerance.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The duty reads as active care within the specified family situation.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is retained only for this good-conduct accompaniment context, not as a generic synonym for friendship.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir varlık yer bakımından ya da hükmen yakında bulunur veya bir hedefe yaklaşır.
branch_activations.carrier: Al-dunyā carries the near domain.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Thumma and marjiʿukum ilayya place a later return after worldly conduct.
branch_activations.activation: Nearness meets the later destination, making the current domain genuine but not final.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Worldly companionship remains binding within a temporal frame.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not make the present duty unreal.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bu yaşam veya karşıtına göre yakın, küçük ya da ilk olan
branch_activations.facet_statement: İçinde bulunulan ilk yaşam, sonraki yaşama göre yakın olan evre olarak adlandırılır.
branch_activations.carrier: Al-dunyā can name the first life in contrast with a later one.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The sequence particle and final return phrase establish a later horizon.
branch_activations.activation: The first-life sense meets the ordered return clause and gives the worldly duty a provisional temporal layer.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The bond is real in this life while the ayah also names a later destination.
branch_activations.boundary: No detailed afterlife chronology is supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Özne, başladığı yere ya da daha önce bulunduğu duruma geri döner.
branch_activations.carrier: Marjiʿukum carries return.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Al-dunyā scopes companionship, and thumma marks a later return to the divine speaker.
branch_activations.activation: The return phrase sets the limit of the near-world setting without canceling its present care.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Family proximity remains meaningful without becoming the final horizon.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made that parents lack ordinary authority or that care stops after this life.

findings.title: Pressure as a bounded snare analogy
findings.claim: The pressured association may be heard by analogy as a snare into which the addressee is being drawn; refusal blocks capture while companionship continues.
findings.mechanism: The carrier tushrika meets the parental pressure and worldly setting, activating a bounded trap image; ṣāhibhumā then keeps the relationship without letting the demanded compliance govern it.
findings.reader_payoff: The demand can appear as a capture risk, while noncompliance remains compatible with continued company.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory analogy, not the literal meaning of the association clause or an allegation of deliberate psychological manipulation; gradual depletion and internal self-facilitation are omitted.

epistemic.reason: The focus supports a pressure/association/companionship chain, but the capture image is a legacy_unbound HFT analogy and receives no inference about duration or inner psychology.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: avın dolandığı kapan ve tuzak benzetmesi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Fiziksel kapan görüntüsü, insanı yakalayıp kendine bağlayan dünya için benzetmeli olarak kullanılır.
branch_activations.carrier: Tushrika carries the association demand; the supplied branch offers a trap image as an analogy for capture.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Parental pressure, the worldly setting, and the refusal command are distinct focus triggers.
branch_activations.activation: A pressured association in worldly life can be pictured as a capture structure, while the command to refuse blocks the demanded compliance.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The association demand becomes newly legible as a capture risk rather than only a disagreement.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch supports an analogy of capture, not a literal trap meaning for tushrika.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: eşlikçi kılmak, yanında götürmek veya uygun düşmek
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişi veya şeyi başka birinin eşlikçisi durumuna getirmek temel işlemdir.
branch_activations.carrier: Ṣāhibhumā carries making or keeping someone a companion.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The separate refusal of obedience supplies the contrast.
branch_activations.activation: The companionship command preserves company while the compliance command is refused.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The ayah separates remaining with the parents from being captured by their demand.
branch_activations.boundary: No inference is made that the relationship itself is a trap.
